messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor about history of liver or kidney disease"
set: ["tell doctor about history of liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of heart disease", "liver or kidney disease", "inform doctor of history of liver disease", "inform doctor of history of kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of seizures or epilepsy", "tell doctor about history of narrow-angle glaucoma", "tell doctor if ever had liver disease or liver impairment", "tell your doctor if you have ever had liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of recent heart attack", "tell doctor about history of long QT syndrome", "tell doctor about history of bleeding or blood clotting disorder", "tell doctor about history of drug addiction or suicidal thoughts", "tell doctor if ever had kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of bipolar disorder (manic depression)", "fluid build-up caused by liver or kidney disease"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
